caption:
Most resolutions are too big. Gym every day, no sugar, run a marathon. Most of us know how that goes by February.

Small habits last longer. These seven take a few minutes each, and none of them need a membership.

Number 7 is the one men skip. ONS figures show around 3 in 4 suicides in England and Wales are men. A weekly call with a mate is a small thing that can mean a lot.

Lads, what's your one change for 2027?

Save this for New Year's Day, and send it to the man who says he'll start on Monday.

#MensHealthUK #NewYearsResolution #MensMentalHealth #HealthyHabitsUK #UKWellness
